## Appearance

Dora maintains a neat and proper appearance, often wearing a nicely starched white dress paired with a black sash. She has gentle, mild hazel eyes, a straight nose, and long, sleek curls that always remain neatly in place.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Dora is a good, quiet, and lovely child who comports herself as a model of proper behavior. Exceptionally neat, faithful, and observant, she never needs to be told how to perform a task twice and meticulously attends to all her small duties. She approaches activities, such as gardening, in a careful, systematic, and industrious manner, maintaining a composed and placid demeanor even under pressure. As she grows, she proves to be remarkably sensible, womanly, and helpful, though her prim and predictable nature can make her seem somewhat monotonous.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), +10 more_

## History

Dora Keith moved to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) alongside her twin brother, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), though she was noted for her quiet perfection compared to her brother's unruly nature. Shortly after her arrival, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) caused her to fall into a pigpen and later locked her in a toolhouse, prompting a frantic search by the household before she was found. Following the death of [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md), money was left in trust for Dora and her brother, allowing them to remain permanently at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). She later attended school, where she was once frightened by a classmate's ghost stories, and was eventually persuaded by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to skip [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to go fishing.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P26](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0026), +18 more_

## Relationships

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

Dora is the twin sister of [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), brought with him to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). While Dora maintains a reputation for quiet perfection, Davy's unruly behavior frequently targets her, such as causing her to fall into a pigpen or locking her inside a toolhouse. Despite his mischief toward her, the two continue to live together under the care of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +27 more_

- Sibling of — twin sister  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +11 more</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--dora.md)

Dora is cared for by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) after moving to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) affectionately welcoming her upon returning home. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) considers Dora to possess quiet perfection, in stark contrast to her troublesome twin brother [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md). During moments of panic, such as when [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) locks Dora in a toolhouse, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) searches frantically to rescue her.

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P26](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0026), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), +6 more_

- Friend of — welcoming her affectionately on her return home (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Again P14](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0014)</sub>
